definitions.explanation: The formal gesture of raising the hand to the forehead, performed by military personnel, police officers, and similar uniformed personnel as a sign of respect.
A formal, respectful greeting or bow. Used in ceremonial or very formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {兵士|へいし}が{敬礼|けいれい}した。
{警官|けいかん}は{上官|じょうかん}に{敬礼|けいれい}をした。
examples.english: The police officer saluted the superior officer.

examples.japanese: {国旗|こっき}に{向|む}かって{敬礼|けいれい}する{姿|すがた}が{印象的|いんしょうてき}だった。
examples.english: The sight of them saluting the national flag was impressive.

examples.japanese: {深|ふか}く{敬礼|けいれい}する。
{来賓|らいひん}に{敬礼|けいれい}を{述|の}べた。
examples.english: They offered a respectful greeting to the guests of honor.

examples.japanese: {式典|しきてん}で{全員|ぜんいん}が{起立|きりつ}して{敬礼|けいれい}した。
examples.english: Everyone stood up and paid their respects at the ceremony.

notes:
Composed of {敬|けい} (respect) + {礼|れい} (etiquette, bow). Most commonly associated with the military salute gesture, but the word originally and more broadly refers to any formal expression of respect.

USAGE:
Used as a noun ({敬礼|けいれい}をする) or as a suru verb ({敬礼|けいれい}する). In school contexts, students may hear {起立|きりつ}、{礼|れい} (Stand, bow) rather than {敬礼|けいれい}, though some schools use {敬礼|けいれい} as well.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敬礼|けいれい}をする — to salute, to pay respects
- {挙手|きょしゅ}{敬礼|けいれい} — hand salute (the standard military salute)
- {最敬礼|さいけいれい} — the deepest bow (45 degrees)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {礼|れい} — bow; the everyday word for a bow or greeting
- {会釈|えしゃく} — a light, casual bow of acknowledgment
- {お辞儀|おじぎ} — a bow; the most common general term for bowing
